summary: Users import Cetus BTEN-pair positions. Block10 rebalances only via BTEN-gated routes. Enrolled positions earn a share of BTEN LP rewards. Protocol takes 2% of realized profits only.

fee.definition: Profit = USD value withdrawn or compounded above the user's imported cost basis for that position. No fee on principal. Fee is taken in the profit asset(s) at harvest/rebalance settle.
fee.recipient: BTEN protocol treasury / BTEN LP support per distribution_destinations.json

userFlow.import: Wallet-sign transfer or share of an eligible Cetus BTEN-pair position NFT / position object into the managed programme.
userFlow.create: Optional: open a new in-range or adjacent BTEN pair position and enroll it.
userFlow.rebalance: Operator/daemon may withdraw OOR, swap with min-out guards, and redeposit in-range using the same safety rules as bten_lp_rebalance_daemon.mjs.
userFlow.withdraw: User can exit; accrued 2% fee is settled on realized profit before return of remainder.
userFlow.rewards: While enrolled, position liquidity accrues a share of BTEN LP rewards from settled gated volume; claim/auto-pay follows programme rules. Exit settles the 2% realized-profit fee, then returns remainder.

operator.rebalancer: laptop/bten_lp_rebalance_daemon.mjs pattern extended to enrolled user positions
operator.gas: SUI gas only from operator budget; never spend user SUI principal for inventory

onChainStatus: policy-first; Move vault escrow/fee settlement ships with v17 programme objects when enrolled positions require trust-minimised custody

gatePolicy.rule: Every user action on Block10 that moves value (swap, rebalance hop, harvest, enroll, withdraw settle) must use a protected BTEN-gated path with min-out and one receipt per finished route. No ungated DEX shortcut for managed-vault flow.
allowedPaths: future turbos adapters with the same seal rule
forbidden: direct non-BTEN venue execution from Block10 managed flow
unsigned operator swaps without gate receipt

lpRewards.source: BTEN LP allocation from settled blocks (EmissionState bten_lp / LpProgramState)
lpRewards.rule: Users who enroll/import eligible BTEN-pair positions receive a proportional share of BTEN LP rewards while enrolled, weighted by eligible programme liquidity.
lpRewards.note: 2% realized-profit fee is separate from LP reward share. Importers keep LP reward eligibility; protocol takes 2% of realized rebalance profits only.
